rule: Verdict include_flag=0; holder stress remains scenario layer.
machine_action: Do not write holder-stress rows to headline additive waterfall or rollup unless explicit future promotion gate passes.
rationale: Existing bond MTM and borrower distress packs are scenario/diagnostic only; holder stress is less mature and must complement without overlap.

rule: A securities MTM dollar may be a trigger state but cannot be counted as D or wealth drag in this pack.
machine_action: Use MTM loss only in thresholds: loss_to_capital, collateral_buffer_consumed, NAV_loss. No direct D entry.
rationale: Prevents same-security coupon-vs-MTM and wealth-channel double counting.

rule: No household wealth-drag entry from holder stress.
machine_action: Fire-sale price impacts can update future price diagnostics; 6C spending salience requires separate promoted evidence and cell mapping.
rationale: Existing bond-NAV wealth response gate remains unmet; competing evidence weakens direct price-spending mapping.

rule: Bank capital-credit supply effect may only use incremental effective capital shortfall after existing 6D inputs and borrower/default losses.
machine_action: loan_supply_reduction = multiplier * max(0, holder_capital_shortfall - existing_6D_capital_loss_input - borrower_loss_already_counted).
rationale: Promotes evidence only as incremental 6D if future gate passes; avoids duplicating borrower distress layer.

rule: Borrower defaults, LGD, foreclosure deadweight, and principal-transfer treatment remain owned by borrower pack.
machine_action: Holder stress can alter funding/credit-supply scenario inputs but may not re-count principal loss or default deadweight for the same loan-family/month.
rationale: Borrower pack already defines incremental-defaults-only and principal-is-transfer rules.

rule: Deposit movement is a funding transfer, not real-resource D.
machine_action: Count only incremental forced-sale cost, failure deadweight, or credit-supply contraction created by deposit flight after liquidity buffers; cap by observed run shares.
rationale: SVB channel is run -> forced sale/failure, not deposit transfer itself.

rule: HTM unrealized loss is not recognized as capital loss unless sale/taint/failure or scenario rule explicitly realizes it.
machine_action: Use repo/FHLB/discount-window liquidity first; apply forced_sale_fraction_bank_liquidity_gap only after liquid sources; set htm_taint_flag if HTM sales occur.
rationale: Fed FSR notes HTM sales can taint portfolios and reduce capital; accounting matters for stress propagation.

rule: Collateral call is transfer; forced sale price impact requires collateral shortfall and five-day delivery failure.
machine_action: ldi_forced_sale = forced_sale_share * max(0, margin_call - immediate_collateral); apply only to leveraged LDI sleeve.
rationale: Matches UK LDI mechanism and avoids counting all pension MTM as drag.

rule: Investor redemptions are transfer; only sales beyond cash/liquid buffer can produce fire-sale price impact.
machine_action: fund_forced_sale = max(0, outflow_share - cash_liquid_buffer_share) * AUM; liquid-first before less-liquid sale.
rationale: Daily redeemability creates first-mover incentive; not every redemption is an economic loss.

rule: All holder-stress scenario effects must net at cell-month after borrower and existing 6C/6D layers.
machine_action: Store `overlap_key = holder_class|instrument_family|shock_month|effect_type`; reject duplicate effect_type in same cell-month unless explicitly marked incremental.
rationale: Same discipline as borrower pack overlap gates.
